Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full technician-tracker payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Your technician is on the way","status":"enroute","headline":"Marcus is heading to your home","etaText":"Arriving in ~15 min","windowText":"Arrival window 1:00–3:00 PM","updatedText":"Updated 1 min ago","technician":{"name":"Marcus Reed","role":"Senior HVAC Technician","rating":4.9,"photoUrl":"","initials":"MR","skills":"AC repair · Heat pumps"},"job":{"number":"WO-48213","type":"AC not cooling","address":"128 Maple Ave"},"steps":[{"label":"Scheduled","state":"done","timeText":"9:00 AM"},{"label":"Dispatched","state":"done","timeText":"12:40 PM"},{"label":"En route","state":"current","timeText":"1:05 PM"},{"label":"Arriving","state":"todo"},{"label":"On site","state":"todo"}],"submitText":"Message technician","submitValue":"I'd like to message my technician","secondaryText":"Reschedule visit","secondaryValue":"I'd like to reschedule my service visit"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Your technician is on the way'.
- 'status' (string, optional): one of scheduled | dispatched | enroute | arriving | onsite | complete. Drives the hero color + label AND derives the 5-step track when 'steps' is omitted. Defaults to enroute.
- 'headline' (string, optional): one short line in the hero, e.g. the technician's first name + what they're doing.
- 'etaText' (string, optional): estimated arrival, shown as a chip, e.g. 'Arriving in ~15 min'.
- 'windowText' (string, optional): the booked arrival window, shown as a chip.
- 'updatedText' (string, optional): small freshness stamp in the hero.
- 'technician' (object, optional but recommended): { 'name' (string, REQUIRED for real content); 'role' (string, optional); 'rating' (number, optional — shown as a star + value); 'photoUrl' (string, optional — falls back to initials if it fails to load); 'initials' (string, optional — 1–2 letters); 'skills' (string, optional — short specialties line) }.
- 'job' (object, optional): { 'number' (string), 'type' (string — the service reason), 'address' (string) } — rendered as ledger rows.
- 'steps' (array, optional): each { 'label' (string, REQUIRED); 'state' (string — done | current | todo); 'timeText' (string, optional) }. If omitted, the track is derived from 'status'.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): primary button label; defaults to no button when absent.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): message sent when the primary button is tapped; defaults to submitText.
- 'secondaryText' (string, optional): ghost button label (e.g. 'Reschedule visit').
- 'secondaryValue' (string, optional): message sent when the secondary button is tapped; defaults to secondaryText.

TEST MODE: if none of headline, technician.name, or steps is present, the card renders built-in sample data. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
